HELP.ENABLE_JMX_MONITORING: Expose the JVM for external monitoring tools.
HELP.LEVEL_SEED: Seed used for new world generation (leave empty for random).
HELP.GAMEMODE: Default gamemode assigned to new players.
HELP.ENABLE_COMMAND_BLOCK: Allow command blocks to execute commands.
HELP.ENABLE_QUERY: Enable the legacy GameSpy Query protocol.
HELP.LEVEL_NAME: Folder name of the world to load.
HELP.MOTD: Message displayed in the multiplayer server list.
HELP.QUERY_PORT: Port reported via the Query protocol.
HELP.PVP: Allow players to damage each other.
HELP.GENERATE_STRUCTURES: Generate villages, temples, and other structures.
HELP.NETWORK_COMPRESSION_THRESHOLD: Packets larger than this (bytes) will be compressed.
HELP.MAX_TICK_TIME: Maximum tick length before the watchdog triggers (ms).
HELP.REQUIRE_RESOURCE_PACK: Force players to accept the resource pack.
HELP.USE_NATIVE_TRANSPORT: Use optimized native networking when available.
HELP.ONLINE_MODE: Verify players with the Minecraft session servers.
HELP.ALLOW_FLIGHT: Permit flying even outside creative mode.
HELP.VIEW_DISTANCE: Chunks sent to players in each direction.
HELP.SERVER_IP: Bind the server to this IP (leave empty for all).
HELP.RESOURCE_PACK_PROMPT: Optional prompt shown alongside the resource pack.
HELP.ALLOW_NETHER: Allow travel to the Nether dimension.
HELP.SERVER_PORT: Port that the server listens on.
HELP.SYNC_CHUNK_WRITES: Synchronously flush chunk writes to disk.
HELP.PREVENT_PROXY_CONNECTIONS: Deny players connecting via known proxies.
HELP.HIDE_ONLINE_PLAYERS: Hide the player list from the status ping.
HELP.RESOURCE_PACK: URL to the resource pack to download.
HELP.ENTITY_BROADCAST_RANGE_PERCENTAGE: Multiply entity tracking range by this percent.
HELP.SIMULATION_DISTANCE: Chunks that are fully simulated by the server.
HELP.PLAYER_IDLE_TIMEOUT: Minutes before idle players are kicked (0 = disabled).
HELP.FORCE_GAMEMODE: Force clients into the default gamemode on join.
HELP.RATE_LIMIT: Maximum incoming connections per second (0 = unlimited).
HELP.WHITE_LIST: Only allow whitelisted players to join.
HELP.BROADCAST_CONSOLE_TO_OPS: Send console messages to operators in chat.
HELP.SPAWN_NPCS: Allow villagers and other NPCs to spawn.
HELP.SPAWN_ANIMALS: Allow passive animals to spawn naturally.
HELP.LOG_IPS: Log connecting player IP addresses to latest.log.
HELP.FUNCTION_PERMISSION_LEVEL: Command permission level required for functions.
HELP.TEXT_FILTERING_CONFIG: Path or URL to a chat filtering configuration.
HELP.SPAWN_PROTECTION: Protect this many blocks around spawn from edits.
HELP.RESOURCE_PACK_SHA1: Optional SHA1 hash of the resource pack.
HELP.MAX_WORLD_SIZE: Limit for generated world border size.
